title: FPRAS for perfect matchings in general graphs
exact_target: Can the number of perfect matchings of an arbitrary explicitly given finite general graph be estimated to relative error $\varepsilon $ with failure probability $\delta $ in worst-case bit time polynomial in input length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with zero returned certainly when there are no perfect matchings?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
